issue.title: [generic-rest 02/09] Mount named custom routes through ModuleRegistry manifests (#239)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #377

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Branch `bb/relay-239-generic-rest-02-09-mount-named-custom-thr_gzk8zqd7kz` pushed to origin.

## Summary

Implements issue #239: extends `ModuleManifest` with an optional `customRoutes` array so a module can declare a named custom route (name, HTTP method, `/api` path, handler export, justification). `ModuleRegistry` fail-fasts on duplicate method+path registration, identifying both owning modules, and rejects any entry missing a `transactional-semantics`/`single-consumer-read` justification.

`semprec-api` mounts these routes at startup via `mountCustomRoutes`, built on the #238 REST adapter (shared auth, validation, status mapping, `{error:{code,details}}` error contract). The four existing named exceptions are now registered exclusively through this mechanism as thin handlers wrapping existing service functions, reimplementing no domain rules:

- `POST /api/proposals/:id/confirm` and `GET /api/inbox-types` (owned by `inboxPipeline`)
- `POST /api/push-subscriptions` / `POST /api/push-subscriptions/:id/revoke` and `GET /api/ai-usage` (owned by `schemaCore`)

Their previous ad hoc prefix-routed handlers in `app.ts` (`aiUsageHandler.ts`, `pushSubscriptionsHandler.ts`) were removed.

`pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, unit/integration/e2e tests) passes cleanly: 197 unit tests, 937 integration tests, 5 e2e tests, all green.

- Added `docs/adr/2026-09-11-module-manifest-custom-routes.md` documenting the custom-route-manifest architectural decision.
- Removed the unused `ModuleRegistry.getCustomRoutes()` / `ModuleCustomRouteProjection` (scope creep — `semprec-api` only ever used `getCustomRouteDefinitions()`).

Full `pnpm run verify` passed (197 unit tests, 937 integration tests, 5 e2e tests, all green) before pushing.
